curriculum.name: Cambridge International Primary (UK)
curriculum.tagline: Global gold-standard curriculum preparing learners for IGCSE
curriculum.description: CAIE framework developing confidence, inquiry, and critical thinking.

term_package.title: Stage 1 Cambridge Primary - Term 1 Master Box
term_package.subtitle: CAIE Aligned: Primary English (0058), Mathematics (0096), Science (0097)
features: 12 Weeks of British International Curriculum Guides
Phonics, Sight Words & Guided Story Reading Framework
Scientific Inquiry: Plants, Habitats, Light & Shadows

weeks.sub_strand: Counting, Number Bonds to 10 & The 5 Senses
learning_outcomes: Explore taste, smell, touch, sight, and hearing

lessons.subject: Cambridge Mathematics (0096)
lessons.parent_script: Look at this ten-frame. If we place 6 red counters, how many empty spaces are left to make 10?
lessons.learning_objective: Recall number pairs that add up to 10 with automaticity.
lessons.step_by_step_activity:
1. Place 7 counters on the ten-frame.
2. Discover that 7 + 3 = 10.
3. Record all number bond combinations in math journal.

lessons.subject: Cambridge Science (0097)
lessons.topic: Exploring the 5 Senses: The Mystery Box
lessons.parent_script: Close your eyes! Put your hand in this mystery box. Describe the texture without peeking!
lessons.learning_objective: Identify body organs associated with each sense and use descriptive scientific vocabulary.
lessons.step_by_step_activity:
1. Blindfolded texture test.
2. Scent identification.
3. Complete the 5 Senses observation chart.

lessons.subject: Cambridge English (0058)
lessons.topic: Guided Reading: Character & Setting in Fiction
lessons.parent_script: Look at the book cover. Where do you think this story takes place? Who is the main character?
lessons.learning_objective: Make simple predictions and identify character and setting in an illustrated story.
lessons.step_by_step_activity:
1. Read the story aloud together.
2. Identify the setting.
3. Draw the main character doing their favourite activity.
